title: Little Red Riding Hood Shocking Reveal
rating_justification: Target rating NC-17 applied (recommended: PG-13). While the story contains dark cyberpunk themes, a sense of dread, and a violent conclusion, it lacks the graphic sexual content, extreme gore, or pervasive profanity required for an NC-17 rating. The violence is implied through 'digital' means (neural-link hijacking and parasitic uploads) rather than explicit physical descriptions. The 'teeth' dialogue is unsettling and macabre, but falls under psychological horror/suspense rather than extreme content.
